prompt02.cause: Each reply includes https://example.com/triangle.png. The harness attached image load/error listeners only from the mutation observer. An image already in the tree does not mutate when it finishes, so data-render-complete was never set. Master and this branch share that harness shell, so both sides timed out. Raising the wait cannot make the predicate true.
prompt02.after: Images already in the tree are armed before the first readiness check. All 7 cells then reached data-render-complete on origin/master and on this branch in about 220ms. textContent and innerText match.

prompt08.cause: The saved replies are empty or whitespace only (two empty strings, one run of newlines). pageStateReady requires visible text, so data-render-complete is never set on either side.
prompt08.after: Both sides settle with fonts loaded, no hidden KaTeX, no pending images, and empty visible text. textContent and innerText match. This is not a head-only regression.
